Agent.text:
I reviewed the capture evidence for the required routes and fixed `app/build.mjs` so footers now use `/privacy`, `/terms`, and `/shop-terms`, the login “Create your storefront →” and “Join here” links point to `/onboard` and `/join`, and home cards/menu/shop rows link to individual `/{slug}` shop URLs as shown in the captures (category browse tiles still point to `/c/...`).
After `npm install` and `npm run build` in `app/`, the site generates the required static pages in `app/dist` for `/`, `/login`, `/c/grocery`, `/c/homefood`, and `/c/rest`.
`rebuild_check` reports the build would pass overall at ~99% likeness for the required pages/widths (including the required opened menu states being triggered), with menu-state visual similarity lower at 1440px (~80–81%) and 390px (~62–65%).
I could not view `capture/*.png` or `capture/states*/*.png` in this session, so any remaining menu-state visual differences below exact parity could not be verified or adjusted from screenshots beyond the JSON/HTML/outline evidence and the checker’s output. No original protected logos, photos, brand names, or long copy were replaced outside what the existing local rebuild assets already provide.
